definitions.explanation: Wild plants that grow where they are not wanted, especially in gardens or fields.

examples.english: Pull out the weeds in the garden.

examples.japanese: {雑草|ざっそう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{抜|ぬ}いても→抜く：02384_nuku⟧⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{生|は}えてくる→生える：02392_haeru⟧。
examples.english: Weeds grow back quickly even after being pulled.

examples.japanese: {雑草|ざっそう}⟦のように→ように：10081_youni⟧⟦{逞|たくま}しく→たくましい：06255_takumashii⟧⟦{生|い}きる→生きる：01184_ikiru⟧。

⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{庭|にわ}→庭：02239_niwa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{雑草|ざっそう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦{生|は}えてきて→生える：02392_haeru⟧⟦{大変|たいへん}→大変：00594_taihen⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: When spring comes, lots of weeds grow in the garden and it's a lot of work.

examples.japanese: ⟦{週末|しゅうまつ}→週末：03030_shuumatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{庭|にわ}→庭：02239_niwa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{雑草|ざっそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抜|ぬ}いて→抜く：02384_nuku⟧、⟦きれいに→きれい：00717_kirei⟧⟦しました→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: On the weekend, the whole family pulled weeds in the garden and made it look nice.

notes:
Though {雑草|ざっそう} literally means 'miscellaneous grass' and is often unwanted, it's also used metaphorically to praise resilience and tenacity.

⟦{雑草魂|ざっそうだましい}→雑草魂：noentry⟧ (weed spirit) is a positive expression meaning 'underdog mentality' or 'never-give-up spirit' - popularized in sports.

Common weeds in Japan:
- ⟦タンポポ→たんぽぽ：05486_tanpopo⟧ (dandelion)
- ⟦カタバミ→カタバミ：noentry⟧ (wood sorrel)
- ⟦オオバコ→オオバコ：noentry⟧ (plantain)
- ⟦セイタカアワダチソウ→セイタカアワダチソウ：noentry⟧ (goldenrod)
- ⟦スギナ→スギナ：noentry⟧ (horsetail)

Related actions:
- {雑草|ざっそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抜|ぬ}く→抜く：02384_nuku⟧ (pull weeds)
- ⟦{草|くさ}むしり→草むしり：08195_kusamushiri⟧ (weeding)
- ⟦{除草|じょそう}→除草：18648_josou⟧する (remove weeds)
- ⟦{除草剤|じょそうざい}→除草剤：24124_josouzai⟧ (herbicide)
